baseline.source: index.html before the Entry Timing revision, 2026-10-19

input.timing: Signal uses OHLCV only through its own dated bar, with at most historyDays bars. Execution must be later than this close.
limitations: This panel reconstructs signals from the captured data; it does not prove those data or this universe were available at each historical date.
Universe selection, delisted instruments, revisions, price adjustments, dividends and original data publication times are not verified by this offline computation.
Explicit provisional rows are excluded; rows without explicit finality are counted as unknown and treated as stored history.
Capture latestDate is not used to label earlier historical bars stale. Exchange calendar gaps require separate execution handling.
Default weights and rule thresholds are unchanged. The new rules were designed after these historical observations; this is retrospective evaluation, not an unseen forward test.
The first minSignalDays minus one accepted bars per instrument are warmup and carry WAIT signals.

assumptions.allocation: Equal initial per-ticker sleeves; fractional shares; no rebalancing.
assumptions.execution: Previous completed session signal executes at the next contiguous session open.
assumptions.terminal: All holdings liquidated at the predeclared final close, including both-side costs. A missing final bar produces a flagged synthetic mark excluded from settled trade statistics.
assumptions.benchmark: Buy at first eligible evaluation-period open after 50 history bars and hold to terminal close.
assumptions.cagrBasis: Actual calendar-date span / 365.25, minimum one day.
assumptions.exposure: Mean invested share of equity at each close before any terminal liquidation.
assumptions.profitFactor: Sum of positive net settled trade profits / absolute sum of negative net settled trade profits; null if no losses.

eventStudy.interpretation: BUY outcome = net long price return. SELL outcome = sell-to-cash then rebuy advantage vs holding, net of both trades, in units of initial position value. Windows overlap across instruments and across model groups; not independent observations.

concentrationDiagnostic.selection: Largest five new-strategy sleeve returns, selected retrospectively solely to disclose concentration.

newVsOld.interpretation: Exploratory 95% interval for the mean paired daily return difference; not a confidence interval for cumulative return, and not proof against universe selection or model-selection bias.

newVsBuyHold.interpretation: Exploratory 95% interval for the mean paired daily return difference; not a confidence interval for cumulative return, and not proof against universe selection or model-selection bias.

limitations: Current selected universe, not point-in-time historical membership; survivorship and selection bias.
Captured revised OHLC prices. No dividends, interest on cash, taxes, regulatory charges or measured spreads. ETF internal expenses are already reflected in quoted prices.
Hypothetical execution at next session open with modeled slippage; no liquidity/capacity constraints. Fractional shares assumed.
Equal initial independent sleeves; not a top-N ranking portfolio. Cash is never reallocated among instruments.
Rules were designed after historical data existed. Annual slices and later start are sensitivity checks, not prospective out-of-sample validation.
No thresholds were fitted or changed based on returns in this analysis.
Terminal close liquidation is predetermined and charged costs; final-day signals do not execute at that close.
Win rate includes executable terminal liquidations; signalExits and terminalExits are reported separately.
Event study counts are correlated across instruments and model categories; event averages are descriptive.
